stem.text: A platform is suspended by four steel wires. Each wire is $5.0\,\text{m}$ long and has a diameter of $3.0\,\text{mm}$. The Young modulus of steel is $2.1 \times 10^{11}\,\text{Pa}$.

stem.alt: Pictorial diagram of a square platform supported by four vertical steel wires, one near each corner, with a block labelled 200 kg on the platform. Labels: steel wires, platform.

stem.text: The wires obey Hooke's law when a load of mass $200\,\text{kg}$ is placed on the platform.
How far will the platform descend because of the extension of the wires?
